purpose: diagnostic only; no new method or label-based hyperparameter/checkpoint selection

machine.environment_note: user requested reuse of installed pytorch environment rather than download torch 2.8; project venv inherits torch, pins NumPy 1.26.4, SciPy 1.13.1 and sklearn 1.4.0

inputs.feature_backbone: DINOv2 ViT-B/14, 768-D frozen CLS, L2 normalize
inputs.subset: identical to stage one; all 30 first-stage index hashes verified

ppot.paper: ICLR 2024, Table 1: CIFAR100-LT R=100 ACC 38.2±0.8%, NMI 69.6±0.3%, F1 32.0±0.9%; Appendix F.1 last ViT-B/16 block fine-tuned

miniclustering.paper: ICLR 2026, Tables 1-2 cover CIFAR-10/CIFAR-20/STL-10 at IR 5/10; no CIFAR-100 fine-label result or official configuration

KM.source: read stage one at K=Ktrue; fresh sklearn KMeans at K sweep

ORACLE_KM.source: read stage one; supervised reference, zero Lloyd steps

KM_ORACLE_INIT.init: actual labeled class means of L2 feature, unnormalized

P2OT_full.status: feature-space adaptation of official P2OT, not paper reproduction
P2OT_full.head: cosine linear 768->K, scale 10
P2OT_full.bank: 5120 logits per head from epoch 2, initialized with first 5120 samples in seed permutation
P2OT_full.checkpoint: lowest average train loss/rho across heads and epochs; no labels
P2OT_full.views: two identical frozen feature copies, cross-view loss; image RandomCrop/Flip/ColorJitter unavailable
P2OT_full.backbone: frozen DINOv2 ViT-B/14, no last-block tuning

P2OT_TRUEPRIOR.sole_change: OT prototype target masses rho*true_class_proportions sorted descending; assign by rank of unlabeled prototype occupancy after epoch 1; freeze rank afterward; no class identity given

MiniClustering_feat.status: feature-space adaptation, no official CIFAR100 configuration
MiniClustering_feat.heads: two linear heads K and M initialized from feature KMeans centroids
MiniClustering_feat.M: 2*K, from CIFAR10 IR100 ratio 20/10 in paper Appendix C; fixed for all conditions
MiniClustering_feat.views: same frozen feature supplied to both views; no image augmentation or BYOL encoder updates

MiniClustering_official.reason: paper and fixed code support CIFAR-20 superclass rather than requested CIFAR-100 fine labels; code has TabError at line 190 and requires 800-epoch BYOL pretraining checkpoint; no original-paper CIFAR100-LT settings to preserve

silhouette.sample: first 2000 positions of RandomState(seed) permutation, fit KMeans on same sample, score same sample
silhouette.selection: maximum silhouette, smaller K on tie; full-data prediction by nearest fitted centroid

evaluation.mapping: rectangular Hungarian maximizing sample count; unmatched true classes recall 0; unmatched clusters map to -1
evaluation.many_to_one: each predicted cluster maps to majority true class; tie smallest class id
evaluation.head_medium_tail: true class size descending, class id ascending tie; 30/40/30 for CIFAR100
evaluation.stage1_tail: floor(Ktrue/3) smallest, class id ascending tie
evaluation.paired: same dataset, IR and seed; strict positive >0

decision.rule1: mean_s(ORACLE_KM - max(P2OT_full,MiniClustering_feat))>=0.10 and at least 4/5 positive; official descriptive only if fewer than five seeds
decision.rule3: at K=70 vs K=100, P2OT_full or KM has mean tail recall drop>=0.05 and >2*head drop, with at least 4/5 seeds satisfying both; IR1 does not meet same asymmetry
decision.combined: three rules each reported separately; support for long-tail plus unknown-K extension only when rule3 true, with rules1-2 contextual diagnostics

runtime.on_failure: stop and preserve logs; no fabricated report
runtime.smoke: cifar100 IR100 seed1, 2 epochs, not in statistics
runtime.rerun: one independent complete P2OT_full cifar100 IR100 seed1 run

label_firewall: labels for LT subset, offline metrics, true prior sizes, oracle initialization only; P2OT_full, MiniClustering_feat, KM and silhouette fitting do not receive labels
